sections.Profile:
"Flower's Child" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine produced by Rally Play Company in 1969. This four-player game features a vibrant, psychedelic theme characteristic of the late 1960s. The playfield includes four flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, five standup targets, and a unique right-side lane equipped with five thrust magnets.

- Manufacturer: Rally play Company
- Years made: 1969
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: People, Trippy, Good Times, Original Theme, Colorful, Music
